ngfe01.title: Says sorry without a "but"
ngfe01.caption: Door 1 and Aries already swatted the "but" right out of the room. An apology with no fine print hits different. Who taught you to say sorry and stop there?

ngfe02.title: Asks how the big thing went
ngfe02.caption: Taurus put your interview on the fridge and texted the minute you walked out. Remembering the date is cute. Asking how it went is the flag. Who always checks in after your big day?

ngfe03.title: Kind to the server
ngfe03.caption: Wrong drink, zero drama, a big thank you. Capricorn's checklist didn't stand a chance. How someone treats the server tells you plenty. Which sign is the nicest regular at your café?

ngfe04.title: Packs a spare pair of gloves
ngfe04.caption: Sagittarius left the house without gloves, as one does. Cancer packed two pairs, as one does. Tag the person who always has a spare.

ngfe05.title: Lets you finish your story
ngfe05.caption: Leo had a thought, swallowed it, and asked what happened next. That's growth. Also, the goose had a scarf. Who in your life lets you get to the good part?

ngfe06.title: Hears "no" the first time
ngfe06.caption: "Not tonight." "Ok! Rest up." No sulking, no second ask, no guilt trip. Scorpio was ready for a negotiation that never came. What's the smallest no you wish people heard?

ngfe07.title: Puts the phone face down at dinner
ngfe07.caption: The phone buzzed. Libra flipped it over without looking and kept listening to Gemini's snow speech. Small move, huge energy. Phone on the table or in the bag at dinner?

ngfe08.title: Says "take your time"
ngfe08.caption: Forty pages of menu, one Taurus, and a Scorpio who never once sighed. Patience is a whole personality. Be honest: are you the menu reader or the one waiting?

ngfe09.title: Celebrates your small wins
ngfe09.caption: One new leaf on a houseplant and Sagittarius threw a full parade. Get you someone who brings a banner to your tiny wins. What small win deserves confetti this week?

ngfe10.title: Asks before posting your photo
ngfe10.caption: Capricorn asked before posting, deleted the blinky one on request, and Leo got the good angle. Consent includes the camera roll. Which friend has your approval on photos?

ngfe11.title: Remembers your friends' names
ngfe11.caption: Rosa, Dev and Kit were not ready for Aquarius to remember their names AND their trip. Instant friend-group approval. Who passed the name test with your people?

ngfe12.title: Checks in when you go quiet
ngfe12.caption: No pressure to reply, just here when you need me. Pisces sent the kindest text and then cried at it, naturally. Who do you text first when you've been quiet a while?

ngfe13.title: Scrapes the frost off your car
ngfe13.caption: Taurus woke up to a clear windshield and an Aries holding a scraper at 7 AM. Winter romance is just chores done with a grin. Who's warming up your car this season?

ngfe14.title: Gives you the bigger half of the blanket
ngfe14.caption: A Taurus voluntarily gave up the bigger half of the blanket. Pisces dropped its tissue. Libra asked who they were. Would you share the big half? Be honest.

ngfe15.title: Shows up when they said
ngfe15.caption: Gemini said seven and knocked at seven. Aries is still processing. Being on time is a quiet way of saying you matter. Who in your group chat is always on the dot?

ngfe16.title: Warms your coat before you leave
ngfe16.caption: Capricorn put on its coat and found it toasty, because Cancer hung it by the heater an hour earlier. The stern face did not survive. Who would think of this for you?

ngfe17.title: Same with you around their friends
ngfe17.caption: No playing it cool in front of the crew: Leo pulled Sag in and introduced them with full pride. Same person, every room. Who's the proudest introducer you know?

ngfe18.title: Tilts the umbrella your way
ngfe18.caption: One umbrella, a lot of snow, and a Virgo with a little snow hat by the end. Worth it, apparently. Who would tilt it your way?

ngfe19.title: Notices your new haircut
ngfe19.caption: Scorpio said nothing about the new haircut. Libra noticed in two seconds anyway. Scorpio played it cool, then did a spin. What's the last change someone noticed right away?

ngfe20.title: Says "have fun" when you make plans
ngfe20.caption: Leo got invited out and Scorpio said go, have fun, tell me everything later, then cracked open a book. Secure is a cozy look. What do you do on a solo night in?

ngfe21.title: Does the dishes when you cook
ngfe21.caption: Cancer cooked, so Sagittarius grabbed the yellow gloves before anyone could argue. "I want to" is doing a lot of work here. In your house, does the cook ever wash up?

ngfe22.title: Keeps your secrets
ngfe22.caption: Gemini asked what Libra said. Capricorn zipped it. Libra beamed from across the room. Being someone people can tell things to is the flag. Who's the vault in your friend group?

ngfe23.title: Remembers the thing you said once
ngfe23.caption: Virgo mentioned loving tangerines one time in October. Aquarius showed up with a whole crate and a bow. Some people actually listen. What's a tiny thing someone remembered about you?

ngfe24.title: Chooses you on ordinary days too
ngfe24.caption: The last door of the calendar: no big plans, just Pisces and Taurus splitting the last piece of toast on a plain Tuesday in January. That's the green flag. Which of the 24 was your favourite?
